std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n178\t    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n179\t\n180\t    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197\t            }\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        // Collect all indices\n201\t        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203\t\n204\t        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205\t    }\n206\t\n207\tprivate:\n208\t    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209\t        minBound = nodeMin;\n210\t        maxBound = nodeMax;\n211\t        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212\t        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t      }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.resize(faces.size());\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t f = 0; f < faces.size(); ++f) {\n            const auto& face = faces[f];\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles[f] = Triangle(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mersenne Twister (bit-exact std::mt19937 replacement)\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1) on libstdc++ evaluates\n// generate_canonical<float,24>, which consumes exactly one 32 bit mt19937 word\n// and returns float(word) * 2^-32 (clamped below 1).  Reproducing the raw word\n// stream therefore reproduces every random value bit-for-bit.\n\nconstexpr int MT_N = 624;\nconstexpr int MT_M = 397;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_MATRIX_A = 0x9908b0dfu;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_UPPER = 0x80000000u;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_LOWER = 0x7fffffffu;\n\n// Number of twists (blocks of MT_N words) covered by one checkpoint chunk.\nconstexpr int TWISTS_PER_CHUNK = 128;\nconstexpr long long CHUNK_DRAWS = static_cast<long long>(MT_N) * TWISTS_PER_CHUNK;\n\nstatic void mtSeed(uint32_t* mt, uint32_t seed) {\n    mt[0] = seed;\n    for (int i = 1; i < MT_N; ++i) {\n        mt[i] = 1812433253u * (mt[i - 1] ^ (mt[i - 1] >> 30)) + static_cast<uint32_t>(i);\n    }\n}\n\n// Advance the state by MT_N words (auto-vectorized: every loop below has a\n// dependence distance of at least 227 elements).\nstatic inline void mtTwist(uint32_t* __restrict__ mt) {\n    uint32_t y;\n    for (int k = 0; k < MT_N - MT_M; ++k) {\n        y = (mt[k] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[k + 1] & MT_LOWER);\n        mt[k] = mt[k + MT_M] ^ (y >> 1) ^ (static_cast<uint32_t>(-static_cast<int32_t>(y & 1u)) & MT_MATRIX_A);\n    }\n    for (int k = MT_N - MT_M; k < MT_N - 1; ++k) {\n        y = (mt[k] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[k + 1] & MT_LOWER);\n        mt[k] = mt[k + (MT_M - MT_N)] ^ (y >> 1) ^ (static_cast<uint32_t>(-static_cast<int32_t>(y & 1u)) & MT_MATRIX_A);\n    }\n    y = (mt[MT_N - 1] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[0] & MT_LOWER);\n    mt[MT_N - 1] = mt[MT_M - 1] ^ (y >> 1) ^ (static_cast<uint32_t>(-static_cast<int32_t>(y & 1u)) & MT_MATRIX_A);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mtTemper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= y >> 11;\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= y >> 18;\n    return y;\n}\n\n// float(word) * 2^-32, matching libstdc++'s generate_canonical<float, 24>.\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t mtCanonical(uint32_t w) {\n    val_t r = static_cast<val_t>(w) * 0x1p-32f;\n    if (r >= 1.0f) r = 0x1.fffffep-1f;  // nextafterf(1, 0)\n    return r;\n}\n\n// Regenerate the raw (tempered) word stream: one block per checkpoint chunk.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(256) void mtGenerateKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ chkStates,\n                                                        uint32_t* __restrict__ out,\n                                                        long long totalWords) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t mt[MT_N];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const long long base = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * CHUNK_DRAWS;\n\n    for (int k = tid; k < MT_N; k += blockDim.x) {\n        mt[k] = chkStates[static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * MT_N + k];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int rep = 0; rep < TWISTS_PER_CHUNK; ++rep) {\n        // Phase A: k in [0, 227)   -- all inputs are old state\n        uint32_t nv = 0;\n        if (tid < MT_N - MT_M) {\n            const int k = tid;\n            const uint32_t y = (mt[k] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[k + 1] & MT_LOWER);\n            nv = mt[k + MT_M] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MT_MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid < MT_N - MT_M) mt[tid] = nv;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Phase B: k in [227, 454) -- mt[k-227] already updated by phase A\n        if (tid < MT_N - MT_M) {\n            const int k = (MT_N - MT_M) + tid;\n            const uint32_t y = (mt[k] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[k + 1] & MT_LOWER);\n            nv = mt[k - (MT_N - MT_M)] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MT_MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid < MT_N - MT_M) mt[(MT_N - MT_M) + tid] = nv;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Phase C: k in [454, 623) -- mt[k-227] already updated by phase B\n        if (tid < 169) {\n            const int k = 454 + tid;\n            const uint32_t y = (mt[k] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[k + 1] & MT_LOWER);\n            nv = mt[k - (MT_N - MT_M)] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MT_MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid < 169) mt[454 + tid] = nv;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Phase D: wrap-around element\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const uint32_t y = (mt[MT_N - 1] & MT_UPPER) | (mt[0] & MT_LOWER);\n            mt[MT_N - 1] = mt[MT_M - 1] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MT_MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const long long obase = base + static_cast<long long>(rep) * MT_N;\n        for (int k = tid; k < MT_N; k += blockDim.x) {\n            const long long o = obase + k;\n            if (o < totalWords) out[o] = mtTemper(mt[k]);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device geometry kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct GTri {\n    Vec3 a, b, c, n;\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const GTri& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    const Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    const Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Moeller-Trumbore algorithm)\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                                      const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1,\n                                                      const Vec3& v2) {\n    const Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    const Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    const Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return CUDART_INF_F_LOCAL;\n\n    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    const Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F_LOCAL;\n\n    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    const val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F_LOCAL;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, const GNode& n) {\n    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - n.center;\n    const Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > n.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > n.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > n.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > n.halfExtent.y * ad.z + n.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON)\n        return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > n.halfExtent.z * ad.x + n.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON)\n        return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > n.halfExtent.x * ad.y + n.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON)\n        return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nconstexpr int TRAVERSAL_STACK = 64;\n\n// Check if the segment from -> to is blocked by any triangle other than src/dst\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const GNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                             const int* __restrict__ triRefs, const GTri* __restrict__ tris,\n                             int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    const Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    const val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    const Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[TRAVERSAL_STACK];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const GNode& node = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (node.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < node.triCount; ++k) {\n                const int idx = triRefs[node.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const GTri& tri = tris[idx];\n                const val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                const int c = node.child[i];\n                if (c >= 0 && rayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[c])) {\n                    if (sp < TRAVERSAL_STACK) stack[sp++] = c;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    const val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    const val_t c = v.dot(normal) / vNorm;\n    return c > ZERO ? c : ZERO;\n}\n\n// One thread per (non-culled) triangle pair.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(128) void kijKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ pairs,\n                                                 long long pairBase, long long numPairs,\n                                                 long long firstGlobalPair, long long rndBase,\n                                                 const uint32_t* __restrict__ rnd,\n                                                 const GTri* __restrict__ tris,\n                                                 const GNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                                 const int* __restrict__ triRefs, int N, int rowLo,\n                                                 int nRows, val_t* __restrict__ kijT) {\n    const long long t = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (t >= numPairs) return;\n\n    const uint32_t code = pairs[pairBase + t];\n    const int i = static_cast<int>(code / static_cast<uint32_t>(N));\n    const int j = static_cast<int>(code % static_cast<uint32_t>(N));\n\n    const GTri triI = tris[i];\n    const GTri triJ = tris[j];\n\n    long long off = (firstGlobalPair + t) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR - rndBase;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        const val_t u0 = mtCanonical(rnd[off + 0]);\n        const val_t v0 = mtCanonical(rnd[off + 1]);\n        const val_t u1 = mtCanonical(rnd[off + 2]);\n        const val_t v1 = mtCanonical(rnd[off + 3]);\n        off += 4;\n\n        const Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, u0, v0);\n        const Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, u1, v1);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, triRefs, tris, i, j)) continue;\n\n        const Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        const val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        const val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.n);\n        const val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.n);\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kijT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * nRows + (i - rowLo)] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// Time delays: column-major (j, i-rowLo) to keep the simulation kernel coalesced.\n__global__ void tauKernel(const GTri* __restrict__ tris, int N, int rowLo, int nRows,\n                          int* __restrict__ tauT) {\n    const int j = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    const int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= nRows || j >= N) return;\n    const int i = rowLo + li;\n    int tau = 0;\n    if (i != j) {\n        const GTri& a = tris[i];\n        const GTri& b = tris[j];\n        const Vec3 ca = (a.a + a.b + a.c) / 3.0f;\n        const Vec3 cb = (b.a + b.b + b.c) / 3.0f;\n        const val_t dist = (ca - cb).norm();\n        tau = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n    tauT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * nRows + li] = tau;\n}\n\n// One thread per receiver triangle; the reduction over j stays sequential so the\n// floating point result matches the original code exactly.\n__global__ void simKernel(int t, const val_t* __restrict__ kijT, const int* __restrict__ tauT,\n                          const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,\n                          val_t* __restrict__ radB, int N, int rowLo, int nRows, int sourceIndex,\n                          int timeOff) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= nRows) return;\n    const int i = rowLo + li;\n\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n\n        const int tauij = tauT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * nRows + li];\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n\n        const val_t kij = kijT[static_cast<size_t>(j) * nRows + li];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        const val_t radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        sumB += fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && t < timeOff) ? 1.0f : ZERO;\n    radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i] = rho[i] * sumB + emission;\n}\n\n// Cross correlation: one block per receiver, one thread per lag.\n__global__ void corrKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB, val_t* __restrict__ corr, int N, int T,\n                           int rowLo, int sourceIndex) {\n    extern __shared__ val_t sh[];\n    val_t* sSrc = sh;\n    val_t* sB = sh + T;\n\n    const int li = blockIdx.x;\n    const int i = rowLo + li;\n\n    for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < T; t += blockDim.x) {\n        sSrc[t] = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + sourceIndex];\n        sB[t] = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < T; t += blockDim.x) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) sum += sSrc[tt - t] * sB[tt];\n        corr[static_cast<size_t>(li) * T + t] = sum;\n    }\n}\n\n// Fallback for very large T (shared memory would not fit).\n__global__ void corrKernelGlobal(const val_t* __restrict__ radB, val_t* __restrict__ corr, int N,\n                                 int T, int rowLo, int sourceIndex) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.x;\n    const int i = rowLo + li;\n    for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < T; t += blockDim.x) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            const val_t pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * N + i];\n            const val_t pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * N + sourceIndex];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        corr[static_cast<size_t>(li) * T + t] = sum;\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void argmaxKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ corr, val_t* __restrict__ distances, int T,\n                             int nRows) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= nRows) return;\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        const val_t s = corr[static_cast<size_t>(li) * T + t];\n        if (s > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = s;\n            bestT = t;\n        }\n    }\n    distances[li] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\n__global__ void countPositiveKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ data, size_t n,\n                                    unsigned long long* __restrict__ out) {\n    size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    unsigned long long local = 0;\n    for (; i < n; i += stride) {\n        if (data[i] > EPSILON) ++local;\n    }\n    atomicAdd(out, local);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation state (host side)\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles = 0;\n    size_t numTimesteps = 0;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix), rank 0 only\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex = 0;\n\n    // Flattened octree + GPU friendly triangle array\n    std::vector<GNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<int> triRefs;\n    std::vector<GTri> gtris;\n\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// Per-GPU context\nstruct DeviceCtx {\n    int dev = 0;\n    int rowLo = 0, rowHi = 0;       // owned receiver triangles\n    long long pairLo = 0, pairHi = 0;  // owned range in the compacted pair list\n\n    GTri* d_tris = nullptr;\n    GNode* d_nodes = nullptr;\n    int* d_triRefs = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* d_pairs = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* d_rnd = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* d_chk = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_kijT = nullptr;\n    int* d_tauT = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_areas = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_rho = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_radB = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_corr = nullptr;\n    val_t* d_dist = nullptr;\n    long long maxChunks = 0;\n\n    int nRows() const { return rowHi - rowLo; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity, bool verbose) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    if (verbose) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (verbose) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    state.nodes.reserve(state.numTriangles);\n    state.triRefs.reserve(state.numTriangles * 4);\n    flattenOctree(&state.octree, state.nodes, state.triRefs);\n\n    // Pack triangles for the device\n    state.gtris.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[i];\n        state.gtris[i] = GTri{t.a, t.b, t.c, t._normal};\n        state.areas[i] = t.area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.assign(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n    state.distances.assign(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state, unsigned long long nonZeroKij) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    const size_t total = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %llu/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\", nonZeroKij, total,\n           100.0f * static_cast<val_t>(nonZeroKij) / static_cast<val_t>(total));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nranks);\n    const bool isRoot = (rank == 0);\n\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (isRoot) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (isRoot) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n        printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n        printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n        printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n        printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // GPU assignment: split the node-local GPUs over the node-local ranks\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    MPI_Comm shmComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &shmComm);\n    int lrank = 0, lsize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(shmComm, &lrank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(shmComm, &lsize);\n\n    int devCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&devCount));\n    if (devCount == 0) {\n        if (isRoot) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices found\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> myDevs;\n    if (devCount >= lsize) {\n        for (int d = lrank * devCount / lsize; d < (lrank + 1) * devCount / lsize; ++d)\n            myDevs.push_back(d);\n    } else {\n        myDevs.push_back(lrank % devCount);\n    }\n    const int nLocalDev = static_cast<int>(myDevs.size());\n\n    // Global part enumeration: part = one GPU worth of rows\n    int partBase = 0;\n    MPI_Exscan(&nLocalDev, &partBase, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    if (rank == 0) partBase = 0;\n    int nParts = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&nLocalDev, &nParts, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Initialize (replicated on every rank; cheap compared to the kernels)\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity, isRoot);\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int T = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps);\n    const int srcIndex = static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex);\n    const int timeOff = T / 2;\n\n    if (isRoot) printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Determine which pairs consume random numbers, and where in the\n    // mt19937 stream each of them starts.\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    std::vector<long long> rowOff(N + 1, 0);\n    {\n        std::vector<long long> rowCnt(N, 0);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            const Vec3 nI = state.gtris[i].n;\n            long long c = 0;\n            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n                const Vec3 nJ = state.gtris[j].n;\n                if (nI.x * nJ.x + nI.y * nJ.y + nI.z * nJ.z > 0.99f) continue;\n                ++c;\n            }\n            rowCnt[i] = c;\n        }\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) rowOff[i + 1] = rowOff[i] + rowCnt[i];\n    }\n    const long long totalPairs = rowOff[N];\n\n    // Balanced contiguous row partition (equal number of ray-traced pairs)\n    std::vector<int> partRow(nParts + 1, N);\n    partRow[0] = 0;\n    for (int p = 1; p < nParts; ++p) {\n        const long long target = totalPairs * p / nParts;\n        const auto it = std::lower_bound(rowOff.begin(), rowOff.end(), target);\n        int r = static_cast<int>(it - rowOff.begin());\n        if (r < partRow[p - 1]) r = partRow[p - 1];\n        if (r > N) r = N;\n        partRow[p] = r;\n    }\n    partRow[nParts] = N;\n\n    // Rows / pairs owned by this rank (contiguous across its GPUs)\n    const int rankRowLo = partRow[partBase];\n    const int rankRowHi = partRow[partBase + nLocalDev];\n\n    // Row counts of every rank (needed for the per-timestep exchange)\n    std::vector<int> rankDevCount(nranks, 1);\n    MPI_Allgather(&nLocalDev, 1, MPI_INT, rankDevCount.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    std::vector<int> rankRowCounts(nranks), rankRowDispls(nranks);\n    {\n        int base = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < nranks; ++r) {\n            rankRowDispls[r] = partRow[base];\n            rankRowCounts[r] = partRow[base + rankDevCount[r]] - partRow[base];\n            base += rankDevCount[r];\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Mersenne-Twister checkpoints for this rank's slice of the stream\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    const long long rankPairLo = rowOff[rankRowLo];\n    const long long rankPairHi = rowOff[rankRowHi];\n    const long long chunkLo = (rankPairLo * DRAWS_PER_PAIR) / CHUNK_DRAWS;\n    const long long chunkHi = (rankPairHi * DRAWS_PER_PAIR + CHUNK_DRAWS - 1) / CHUNK_DRAWS;\n    const long long nChunks = std::max<long long>(0, chunkHi - chunkLo);\n\n    std::vector<uint32_t> chkStates(static_cast<size_t>(nChunks) * MT_N);\n    {\n        alignas(64) uint32_t mt[MT_N];\n        mtSeed(mt, 42);\n        for (long long c = 0; c < chunkHi; ++c) {\n            if (c >= chunkLo) {\n                memcpy(&chkStates[static_cast<size_t>(c - chunkLo) * MT_N], mt,\n                       MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t));\n            }\n            for (int rep = 0; rep < TWISTS_PER_CHUNK; ++rep) mtTwist(mt);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Compacted pair list for this rank's rows\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    std::vector<uint32_t> pairList(static_cast<size_t>(rankPairHi - rankPairLo));\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = rankRowLo; i < rankRowHi; ++i) {\n        const Vec3 nI = state.gtris[i].n;\n        size_t w = static_cast<size_t>(rowOff[i] - rankPairLo);\n        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            const Vec3 nJ = state.gtris[j].n;\n            if (nI.x * nJ.x + nI.y * nJ.y + nI.z * nJ.z > 0.99f) continue;\n            pairList[w++] = static_cast<uint32_t>(i) * static_cast<uint32_t>(N) +\n                            static_cast<uint32_t>(j);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Per-GPU setup\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    std::vector<DeviceCtx> ctxs(nLocalDev);\n    const long long maxRndWords = 96LL * 1024 * 1024;  // 384 MB staging buffer per GPU\n    const long long maxChunks = std::max<long long>(1, maxRndWords / CHUNK_DRAWS);\n\n    const int ompDev = std::max(1, nLocalDev);\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ompDev) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int d = 0; d < nLocalDev; ++d) {\n        DeviceCtx& c = ctxs[d];\n        c.dev = myDevs[d];\n        c.rowLo = partRow[partBase + d];\n        c.rowHi = partRow[partBase + d + 1];\n        c.pairLo = rowOff[c.rowLo];\n        c.pairHi = rowOff[c.rowHi];\n        const int nr = c.nRows();\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_tris, sizeof(GTri) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_tris, state.gtris.data(), sizeof(GTri) * N,\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_nodes, sizeof(GNode) * state.nodes.size()));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_nodes, state.nodes.data(), sizeof(GNode) * state.nodes.size(),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_triRefs, sizeof(int) * std::max<size_t>(1, state.triRefs.size())));\n        if (!state.triRefs.empty()) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_triRefs, state.triRefs.data(),\n                                  sizeof(int) * state.triRefs.size(), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_areas, sizeof(val_t) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_areas, state.areas.data(), sizeof(val_t) * N,\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_rho, sizeof(val_t) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_rho, state.rho.data(), sizeof(val_t) * N,\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_radB, sizeof(val_t) * static_cast<size_t>(T) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(c.d_radB, 0, sizeof(val_t) * static_cast<size_t>(T) * N));\n\n        if (nr > 0) {\n            const size_t mat = static_cast<size_t>(N) * nr;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_kijT, sizeof(val_t) * mat));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(c.d_kijT, 0, sizeof(val_t) * mat));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_tauT, sizeof(int) * mat));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_corr, sizeof(val_t) * static_cast<size_t>(nr) * T));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_dist, sizeof(val_t) * nr));\n\n            const size_t np = static_cast<size_t>(c.pairHi - c.pairLo);\n            if (np > 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_pairs, sizeof(uint32_t) * np));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_pairs, pairList.data() + (c.pairLo - rankPairLo),\n                                      sizeof(uint32_t) * np, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                const long long myChunks =\n                    std::min<long long>(maxChunks,\n                                        (c.pairHi * DRAWS_PER_PAIR + CHUNK_DRAWS - 1) / CHUNK_DRAWS -\n                                            (c.pairLo * DRAWS_PER_PAIR) / CHUNK_DRAWS);\n                c.maxChunks = std::max<long long>(1, myChunks);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_rnd, sizeof(uint32_t) * c.maxChunks * CHUNK_DRAWS));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&c.d_chk, sizeof(uint32_t) * c.maxChunks * MT_N));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // ==================================================================\n    // Precomputation: time delays + form factors\n    // ==================================================================\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    if (isRoot) printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ompDev) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int d = 0; d < nLocalDev; ++d) {\n        DeviceCtx& c = ctxs[d];\n        if (c.nRows() <= 0) continue;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n        const dim3 blk(64, 4);\n        const dim3 grd((c.nRows() + blk.x - 1) / blk.x, (N + blk.y - 1) / blk.y);\n        tauKernel<<<grd, blk>>>(c.d_tris, N, c.rowLo, c.nRows(), c.d_tauT);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n\n    if (isRoot) printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ompDev) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int d = 0; d < nLocalDev; ++d) {\n        DeviceCtx& c = ctxs[d];\n        if (c.nRows() <= 0 || c.pairHi <= c.pairLo) continue;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n\n        long long p = c.pairLo;\n        while (p < c.pairHi) {\n            const long long firstChunk = (p * DRAWS_PER_PAIR) / CHUNK_DRAWS;\n            // How many pairs fit into maxChunks chunks starting at firstChunk?\n            const long long lastDraw = (firstChunk + c.maxChunks) * CHUNK_DRAWS;\n            long long pEnd = std::min(c.pairHi, lastDraw / DRAWS_PER_PAIR);\n            if (pEnd <= p) pEnd = p + 1;  // safety (cannot happen: chunk >> 64)\n            const long long nch =\n                (pEnd * DRAWS_PER_PAIR + CHUNK_DRAWS - 1) / CHUNK_DRAWS - firstChunk;\n\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_chk,\n                                  chkStates.data() + static_cast<size_t>(firstChunk - chunkLo) * MT_N,\n                                  sizeof(uint32_t) * static_cast<size_t>(nch) * MT_N,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n            const long long rndBase = firstChunk * CHUNK_DRAWS;\n            const long long words = pEnd * DRAWS_PER_PAIR - rndBase;\n            mtGenerateKernel<<<static_cast<int>(nch), 256>>>(c.d_chk, c.d_rnd, words);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n            const long long npairs = pEnd - p;\n            const int blkSize = 128;\n            const long long grid = (npairs + blkSize - 1) / blkSize;\n            kijKernel<<<static_cast<int>(grid), blkSize>>>(\n                c.d_pairs, p - c.pairLo, npairs, p, rndBase, c.d_rnd, c.d_tris, c.d_nodes,\n                c.d_triRefs, N, c.rowLo, c.nRows(), c.d_kijT);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n            p = pEnd;\n        }\n    }\n\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ompDev) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int d = 0; d < nLocalDev; ++d) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(ctxs[d].dev));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == N) {\n                printf(\"  Progress: %d/%d triangles\\n\", i + 1, N);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", (long)preDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // ==================================================================\n    // Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n    // ==================================================================\n    auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    if (isRoot) printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const bool exchange = (nParts > 1);\n    std::vector<val_t> rowLocal(std::max(1, rankRowHi - rankRowLo));\n    std::vector<val_t> rowFull(N);\n\n    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ompDev) schedule(static, 1)\n        for (int d = 0; d < nLocalDev; ++d) {\n            DeviceCtx& c = ctxs[d];\n            if (c.nRows() <= 0) continue;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n            const int blk = 128;\n            simKernel<<<(c.nRows() + blk - 1) / blk, blk>>>(t, c.d_kijT, c.d_tauT, c.d_areas,\n                                                            c.d_rho, c.d_radB, N, c.rowLo,\n                                                            c.nRows(), srcIndex, timeOff);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            if (exchange) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(rowLocal.data() + (c.rowLo - rankRowLo),\n                                      c.d_radB + static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + c.rowLo,\n                                      sizeof(val_t) * c.nRows(), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (exchange) {\n            if (nranks > 1) {\n                MPI_Allgatherv(rowLocal.data(), rankRowHi - rankRowLo, MPI_FLOAT, rowFull.data(),\n                               rankRowCounts.data(), rankRowDispls.data(), MPI_FLOAT,\n                               MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            } else {\n                memcpy(rowFull.data() + rankRowLo, rowLocal.data(),\n                       sizeof(val_t) * (rankRowHi - rankRowLo));\n            }\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ompDev) schedule(static, 1)\n            for (int d = 0; d < nLocalDev; ++d) {\n                DeviceCtx& c = ctxs[d];\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(c.d_radB + static_cast<size_t>(t) * N, rowFull.data(),\n                                      sizeof(val_t) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (isRoot && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T)) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %d/%d\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ompDev) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int d = 0; d < nLocalDev; ++d) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(ctxs[d].dev));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto simDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", (long)simDuration);\n        printf(\"\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // ==================================================================\n    // Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n    // ==================================================================\n    auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    if (isRoot) printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    std::vector<val_t> distLocal(std::max(1, rankRowHi - rankRowLo));\n\n#pragma omp parallel for num_threads(ompDev) schedule(static, 1)\n    for (int d = 0; d < nLocalDev; ++d) {\n        DeviceCtx& c = ctxs[d];\n        if (c.nRows() <= 0) continue;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(c.dev));\n        const size_t shmem = sizeof(val_t) * 2 * static_cast<size_t>(T);\n        const int threads = std::min(1024, std::max(32, ((T + 31) / 32) * 32));\n        if (shmem <= 47 * 1024) {\n            corrKernel<<<c.nRows(), threads, shmem>>>(c.d_radB, c.d_corr, N, T, c.rowLo, srcIndex);\n        } else {\n            corrKernelGlobal<<<c.nRows(), threads>>>(c.d_radB, c.d_corr, N, T, c.rowLo, srcIndex);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        const int blk = 128;\n        argmaxKernel<<<(c.nRows() + blk - 1) / blk,
